# Mixed-input selection differential (probe Temp/opencode/mixedprobe, SDK 10.0.401).
# Reference: GameStructure.Load over a mixed directory (dir) and over an
# explicit two-file list (list), dumping MixedGameStructure Files (name=path,
# {DIR} is the case directory). Rust parity rebuilds the same tree in a
# scratch VFS and runs MixedGameStructure::from_vfs_paths over the directory
# selection and over the explicit file selection.
# Notable reference facts pinned here: split parts fold to one split.assets
# entry; walked bundle/web keys use short names (extra, patch) while explicit
# file keys keep full names (extra.bundle); blob.resS registers nowhere.
